title: Understanding and Improving Deep Neural Network for Activity Recognition

novelty_points.claim: 通过可视化卷积神经网络提取的传感器活动特征，分析活动与特征的关系，并将显著特征送入DNN融合模型进行人体活动识别。
novelty_points.claim_en: Visualizes sensor activity features extracted by a convolutional network, analyzes their relationship to activities, and feeds significant features to a DNN fusion model for human activity recognition.
technical_features: 在智能手机人体活动识别数据上使用卷积神经网络提取特征。
可视化所提取特征，分析神经网络依靠哪些特征识别活动。
将与活动相关的显著特征输入基于DNN的融合模型。
technical_features_en: Extracts features with a convolutional neural network on the Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones dataset.
Visualizes extracted features to analyze how the network identifies activities.
Feeds significant activity-related features to a DNN-based fusion model.
